summary: Trier raised on-street parking fees (zone 1 EUR 2.80/h) and SWT garage tariffs (EUR 2.40/h) in January 2024, and set resident permits at EUR 200, which the council froze in December 2024 after a 38-13 vote. The city's parking concept steers long stays into the seven SWT-run garages (about 3,200-3,330 spaces, 'rarely fully occupied'), while the Urban Security Concept has removed kerbside spaces and extended the pedestrian zone. From January 2026 SWT discount digital 'Komfort-Parken' to EUR 1.92/h in five garages, added EUR 15/month night parking in April 2026 and extended the scheme to Plaza-Carrée in May 2026. Demand is shaped by commuters (8,880 residents work in Luxembourg), four to five million day tourists a year, and the 2025 reopening of the West Line rail link with small park-and-ride sites.

items.text: In September 2023 Trier's transport department proposed raising on-street parking fees from 1 January 2024 to EUR 3.00 per hour in fee zone 1 (inside the Alleenring, then EUR 2.20) and EUR 1.50 in zone 2 (then EUR 1.10), citing the 2024 budget and municipal-supervision requirements. The same proposal raised resident parking permits from the nationwide EUR 30.70 a year (about 4,150 permits then issued) to a starting fee of EUR 200, and said SWT garage tariffs would be raised to a maximum of EUR 2.40 per hour. These were proposals at that date.
items.source_title: ++ Trier: “Preis-Hammer” – Parken und Anwohnerparken soll deutlich teurer werden – Alle Infos ++

items.text: In its last session of 2023 Trier's city council debated the fee increases taking effect in January 2024: street parking inside the Alleenring rises from EUR 2.20 to EUR 2.80 per hour (EUR 2.70 with the Pay by Phone app), EUR 1.40 in the outer districts, and Stadtwerke Trier raise tariffs in their garages and underground car parks from EUR 2 to EUR 2.40 per hour. The article says the price gap is meant to make garages preferred and reduce parking-search traffic.
items.source_title: ++ Gebühren-Erhöhung in Trier: So teuer wird das Parken ab Januar ++

items.text: The December 2023 council session approved extending resident parking zone South southwards to Aulstraße, due to take effect in the second quarter of 2024. Resident permit fees rise from EUR 30.70 to EUR 200 in January 2024 and, as then planned, in steps to EUR 365 by 2028. The administration set the fees without a council vote under a new state regulation under which councils are only 'heard', which drew heavy criticism in the council.
items.source_title: ++ Gebühren-Erhöhung in Trier: So teuer wird das Parken ab Januar ++

items.text: Trier's parking fee ordinance (council heard on 7 December 2023, in force 1 January 2024) sets EUR 2.80 per hour at on-street short-stay spaces with ticket machines in fee zone 1 (the inner city bounded by Johanniterufer, Nordallee, Theodor-Heuss-Allee, Ostallee, Weimarer Allee and Südallee, among others) and EUR 1.40 in zone 2; mobile-app payment is reduced to EUR 2.70 and EUR 1.35 until 31 December 2025.
items.source_title: Gebührenordnung für die Festsetzung der Gebühren für das Parken in der Stadt Trier

items.text: The city's parking concept says the seven garages and underground car parks operated by Stadtwerke Trier offer a capacity of 3,200 spaces that are only very rarely fully occupied. Its stated guiding aims are less parking-search traffic and moving long-stay parking into garages, with garage tariffs always lower than on-street or large open car parks; the fee structure from January 2024 is EUR 2.80 per hour on street and in public car parks inside the Alleenring versus EUR 2.40 per hour in garages.
items.source_title: Parkraumkonzept

items.text: In May 2024 the Freie Wähler Trier said, citing the city administration, that 82 of the original 162 parking spaces in the affected inner-city area had been removed without replacement, including managed and disabled spaces. This came amid criticism from IHK Trier (survey of about 90 businesses) and the CDU of the Urban Security Concept (high-security bollards, extended pedestrian zone, delivery-time limits, exemption-permit fees).
items.source_title: Trier: Über 50 % weniger Parkplätze - Weiter Kritik an Erweiterung der Fußgängerzone

items.text: Trier's Bewohnerparkgebührenordnung of 9 December 2024 sets the resident parking permit fee at EUR 200 per year (EUR 10 for a replacement or amended permit), in force from 1 January 2025.
items.source_title: Rechtsverordnung über die Erhebung von Gebühren für Bewohnerparken in der Stadt Trier (Bewohnerparkgebührenordnung)

items.text: In early December 2024 (reported 5 December) Trier's city council approved by 38 votes to 13 a motion from CDU, Greens and FDP freezing resident parking fees (moratorium) at EUR 200 a year; the earlier plan had been annual increases of EUR 40 from 2025. AfD, Die Linke and smaller groups voted against.
items.source_title: Gebührenstopp statt Entlastung: Trierer Stadtrat friert Bewohnerparkgebühren ein

items.text: Wochenspiegel reported on 9 December 2024 that the council's moratorium on resident parking fee rises is technically a recommendation, as final authority over the fee rests with transport councillor Dr. Thilo Becker; the plan it replaced would have raised fees to EUR 365.
items.source_title: Streit um Bewohnerparken: Stadtrat setzt Erhöhungen vorerst aus - Stadt Trier - Wochenspiegel

items.text: Passenger trains have run again on Trier's West Line since 3 March 2025 for the first time since 1983, with stops at Hafenstraße, Trier-Pallien, Trier-West, Trier-Euren and Trier-Zewen; RB 83 runs hourly Mon-Sat between Wittlich and Luxembourg City. The city lists park-and-ride capacity of 30 spaces at Hafenstraße and 40 at Euren.
items.source_title: Reaktivierung der Trierer Weststrecke

items.text: The city's economic report of 31 July 2025 says that on 30 June 2024, 55,954 employees worked in Trier, with 30,050 commuting in and 19,560 out; 8,880 out-commuters (45.4 per cent) go to Luxembourg, while only 110 Luxembourg residents commute in. Out-commuters have risen 24.4 per cent since 2015.
items.source_title: Gehälter, Pendlerzahlen und Tourismus: Aktueller Wirtschaftsbericht für die Stadt

items.text: The same city report says about four to five million day tourists visit Trier each year, of whom on average 400,000 stay overnight; 2023 set a record of 892,196 overnight stays, and 2024 had 468,645 guest arrivals.
items.source_title: Gehälter, Pendlerzahlen und Tourismus: Aktueller Wirtschaftsbericht für die Stadt

items.text: In August 2025 the CDU-Greens-FDP ('Jamaika') coalition announced a 'City of the Future' motion for the council meeting of 17 September 2025. It proposed that garage tariffs on low-demand weekdays (Mon-Wed) and in evening and night hours be significantly cheaper than kerbside parking, and that minute-based billing or free parking of up to 30 minutes be examined. These were proposals at that date.
items.source_title: Trier: Billig-Parken, grüne Oasen und Co.: Jamaika-Bündnis legt Plan für "City der Zukunft" vor

items.text: Announced on 5 November 2025: from 1 January 2026 SWT cut the hourly price for digital 'Komfort-Parken' (app plus licence-plate recognition) from EUR 2.40 to EUR 1.92 (20 per cent) in five garages: City-Parkhaus, Viehmarkt, Hauptmarkt, Basilika and Konstantin. Ticket users pay the previous price. The scheme runs initially for one year, and the article says SWT want to establish the app and plate recognition as standard.
items.source_title: ++ Trier: SWT senkt Preise in Parkhäusern - aber nur bei digitaler Nutzung ++

items.text: From 1 April 2026 SWT added 'Nachtparken' for Komfort-Parken users: a flat EUR 15 per month to park from 17:00 to 09:00, Monday to Sunday, in the five SWT garages with licence-plate recognition (City-Parkhaus, Viehmarkt, Hauptmarkt, Basilika, Konstantin).
items.source_title: SWT Nachtparken Trier: Günstig über Nacht parken in der Innenstadt ab 15 Euro monatlich - 5VIER - 54... Trier-Mosel-Eifel-Hunsrück

items.text: On 25 May 2026 SWT reported that the Plaza-Carrée underground garage had new payment machines and barriers and licence-plate recognition, and that its tariff was cut to EUR 1.20 per 30 minutes (previously EUR 2.50 per 60 minutes), with a EUR 18 daily maximum and EUR 3.60 on Sundays and holidays (previously EUR 18); Komfort-Parken and Nachtparken now also work there.
items.source_title: Smarter parken in Trier - Komfort- und Nachtparken ab sofort auch in der Tiefgarage Plaza-Carrée möglich - 5VIER - 54... Trier-Mosel-Eifel-Hunsrück

items.text: Under the Urban Security Concept Trier's pedestrian zone has been extended around Domfreihof, Konstantinstraße and Neustraße; with Neustraße made a pedestrian street, public parking spaces were removed. From 24 June 2026 the bollards at Stockplatz are in operation, completing five bollard lines around Hauptmarkt. Vehicles entering the pedestrian zone need an exemption permit.
items.source_title: Sichere Innenstadt, Stadt Trier

items.text: The city lists seven public garages and underground car parks around the centre run by Stadtwerke Trier (operator SWT Parken GmbH), with 3,330 spaces in total, open around the clock: City Parkhaus, Parkhaus Hauptmarkt, Parkhaus Plaza-Carrée, Tiefgarage Konstantin, Tiefgarage Basilika, Tiefgarage Viehmarkt and Parkhaus Ostallee. A parking guidance system (Parkleitsystem) shows free spaces.
items.source_title: Parkhäuser

items.text: Deutsche Bahn's station page for Trier Hbf lists three parking options: 35 spaces at Bahnhofsplatz 8 and 34 at Moltkestraße (both open-air, 2-hour limit, ticket machine), and a covered garage 'Ostallee' on Fabrikstraße with 860 spaces, EUR 2.40 per hour and EUR 18.00 per 24 hours. The page is undated.
items.source_title: Parken – Trier Hbf

items.text: Trier designates two free park-and-ride sites: Messepark in Trier-West (24 hours, except during events; bus line 13 every 15 minutes Mon-Fri 06:30-18:00; line 303 for commuters to Luxembourg) and Trier-Nord/Verteilerkreis (06:00-19:00). The page is undated.
items.source_title: Park & Ride

items.text: In 2013 SWT Parken equipped all its inner-city garages and underground car parks with individual-space detection showing the shortest route to the nearest free space. The same article says Christmas-season visitors include many shoppers from Luxembourg and the Saarland, and that free park-and-ride buses ran on Advent Saturdays from Messepark, the university (Hochschule) and P+R Trier Nord, with SWT Parken taking part.
items.source_title: City-Initiative Trier e.V.: Parken in der Weihnachtszeit - 5VIER - 54... Trier-Mosel-Eifel-Hunsrück

items.text: In September 2021 SWT said they operated 64 public charging points in Trier, located in parking garages and public car parks, and launched a model letting customers charge at public stations at their household electricity rate via the Portazon app.
items.source_title: Trier: Öffentlich Laden zum selben Preis wie zuhause | ZFK

items.text: In November 2024 SWT opened a charging park at Ruwerer Straße 19a with four charging columns and eight charging points of up to 400 kW, which Mayor Wolfram Leibe called the largest public charging park in the city (not located in a garage).
items.source_title: Größte, öffentliche Schnellladestation für Trier - Stadt Trier - Wochenspiegel

items.text: Moselaufstieg (western bypass of Trier, planned c. 6 km link between B 51 at Konz and A 64): the city council spoke against the project by majority in 2019, while the Trier-Saarburg district council still mostly supports it. In September 2025 the environmental impact study was expected to finish by end-2025, with the next coordination step (preferred-variant pre-selection) possible in Q1 2026. Secondary source (Wikipedia); no outcome for 2026 verified.
items.source_title: Moselaufstieg – Wikipedia
